description:
JEWEL COURT | JEWELLERY QUARTER | Well Presented 1 Bed apartment in Move-in Condition | Modern Open Plan Living Space with ALLOCATED PARKING | VACANT POSSESSION | NO UPWARD CHAIN |

Welcome to Jewel Court, strategically located to benefit and enjoy the historic Jewellery Quarter while still being within easy walking distance of the likes of Colmore Row business district and Brindley Place. The likes of New Street Station, Chinatown and so much more are also easily reachable on foot, making this development an incredibly convenient place to live.

This ground floor apartment faces internally towards the development's communal courtyard and comprises of entrance hallway, store room, open plan living room and well-appointed, modern bathroom with shower over bath. The apartment benefits greatly from a large bedroom that offers ample room to create a work-from-home space as well as room for large wardrobes and drawers.

This apartment is sold with a secure, allocated parking space which is a massive plus, particularly for the Jewellery Quarter area, while there is also no upward chain which adds to the appeal of this property.

Tenure - Leasehold. We are advised by the vendor that there is approx.992 years remaining on the current lease.
Service Charge- We are advised by the vendor that the current service charge is approx. £1,500 per annum.
Ground Rent- We are advised by the vendor that the current ground rent is approx. £TBC per annum.
*Lease, ground rent and service charge details have been provided by the seller and their accuracy cannot be guaranteed. Should you proceed with the purchase of this property, these details must be verified by your Solicitor.*

Services - Mains Water, mains electricity and mains drainage
Local Authority - Birmingham City Council, Council House, Victoria Square, Birmingham
